content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To get dressed in beach clothes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply waterproof facial moisturizer (2 minutes)
Step 2. Select a pair of polarized sunglasses (1 minute)
Step 3. Check the weather forecast for UV index (3 minutes)
Step 4. Locate the beach bag in the closet (2 minutes)
Step 5. Pack a dry change of clothes (3 minutes)
Step 6. Fold a large beach towel (2 minutes)
Step 7. Choose a swimsuit from the drawer (1 minute)
Step 8. Pack a bottle of cold water (30 seconds)
Step 9. Rinse off any lingering lotion from hands (45 seconds)
Step 10. Put on a wide-brimmed sun hat (30 seconds)
Step 11. Secure hair with a waterproof tie (1 minute)
Step 12. Locate the flip-flops (2 minutes)
Step 13. Find the protective case for the sunglasses (1 minute)
Step 14. Apply lip balm with SPF (30 seconds)
Step 15. Retrieve a clean swimsuit cover-up (2 minutes)
Step 16. Shake out the sand from last time's sandals (1 minute)
Step 17. Clean the lenses of the sunglasses (1 minute)
Step 18. Step into the swimsuit (1 minute)
Step 19. Adjust the swimsuit straps for comfort (45 seconds)
Step 20. Check the reflection in the full-length mirror (30 seconds)
Step 21. Find the waterproof phone pouch (2 minutes)
Step 22. Apply a base layer of sunscreen to the torso (5 minutes)
Step 23. Pull the cover-up over the swimsuit (1 minute)
Step 24. Apply sunscreen to the arms (3 minutes)
Step 25. Check for any holes or tears in the beach gear (4 minutes)
Step 26. Toss a snack into the bag (1 minute)
Step 27. Put on a pair of comfortable beach shorts (1 minute)
Step 28. Apply sunscreen to the tops of the feet (2 minutes)
Step 29. Lay out the clothes on the bed (2 minutes)
Step 30. Empty the pockets of the beach shorts (1 minute)
Step 31. Apply sunscreen to the legs (4 minutes)
Step 32. Buckle the straps on the sandals (1 minute)
Step 33. Apply a second coat of lip balm (30 seconds)
Step 34. Put on a lightweight linen shirt (2 minutes)
Step 35. Inspect the beach bag for old trash (3 minutes)
Step 36. Roll up the beach towel tightly (2 minutes)
Step 37. Check the swimsuit fit while moving (1 minute)
Step 38. Find the portable Bluetooth speaker (2 minutes)
Step 39. Put on a beaded beach necklace (1 minute)
Step 40. Open the drawer containing summer accessories (1 minute)
Step 41. Apply sunscreen to the face and neck (3 minutes)
Step 42. Check the expiration date on the sunscreen bottle (1 minute)
Step 43. Rub sunscreen into the shoulders and back (5 minutes)
Step 44. Grab a baseball cap as a backup (1 minute)
Step 45. Place the folded towel into the bag (30 seconds)
Step 46. Find a mesh bag for wet items (2 minutes)
Step 47. Zip up the main compartment of the beach bag (30 seconds)
Step 48. Let the sunscreen dry on the skin (10 minutes)
Step 49. Choose a pair of waterproof sandals (1 minute)
Step 50. Take the swimsuit out of the laundry basket (1 minute)
Step 51. Place the phone pouch in a secure pocket (30 seconds)
Step 52. Locate a light cardigan for the breeze (2 minutes)
Step 53. Set out all necessary toiletries (5 minutes)
Step 54. Find a pair of ankle straps (2 minutes)
Step 55. Adjust the hat to sit firmly on the head (30 seconds)
Step 56. Check that the swimsuit is dry (1 minute)
Step 57. Find a wristband for the locker (1 minute)
Step 58. Put on a sarong over the swimsuit (2 minutes)
Step 59. Decide which bag to use for the day (2 minutes)
Step 60. Fasten the swimsuit clasp (30 seconds)
Step 61. Charge the portable speaker (1 hour)
Step 62. Find a hairbrush for beach hair (2 minutes)
Step 63. Apply sunscreen to the ears (1 minute)
Step 64. Put on a waterproof watch (1 minute)
Step 65. Gather all loose beach items on the table (5 minutes)
Step 66. Test the waterproof seal on the phone pouch (2 minutes)
Step 67. Double-check for the beach umbrella (3 minutes)
Step 68. Tie the swimsuit side-strings (1 minute)
Step 69. Apply sunscreen to the back of the neck (2 minutes)
Step 70. Place the change of clothes in the bag (1 minute)
Step 71. Slide the sunglasses onto the face (15 seconds)
Step 72. Check the tread on the sandals (1 minute)
Step 73. Find a spare hair tie (1 minute)
Step 74. Attach a keychain to the bag (30 seconds)
Step 75. Fasten the linen shirt buttons (1 minute)
Step 76. Smooth out the swimsuit fabric (30 seconds)
Step 77. Walk to the door in the beach shoes (30 seconds)
Step 78. Sort through the clean laundry for beach wear (10 minutes)
Step 79. Find the beach mat (3 minutes)
Step 80. Tuck the linen shirt into the shorts (1 minute)
Step 81. Check the elastic on the swimsuit (1 minute)
Step 82. Locate the sunglasses cord (1 minute)
Step 83. Slip into the sandals (30 seconds)
Step 84. Ensure the beach bag is empty of sand (2 minutes)
Step 85. Check the reflection one last time (30 seconds)
Step 86. Grab the car keys (30 seconds)
Step 87. Put on the sun hat (15 seconds)
Step 88. Check the bag weight (30 seconds)
Step 89. Hang the sunglasses on the shirt collar (15 seconds)
Step 90. Put on a light spray of body mist (30 seconds)
